evals.prompt: I'm opening a new weekly farmers market — permits, vendor outreach, site setup, and promotion. Create a project schedule in YAML with groups, milestones, and task dependencies. Put it in ~/farmers_market/schedule.yaml with a calendar file.
evals.expected_output: Valid schedule YAML with kind-first items, id 0 planning kickoff milestone, groups/tasks/milestones following data_model rules, timing: auto on every task unless pinned, predecessors as MS Project strings, separate calendar.yaml, no date/start/finish on auto tasks

evals.prompt:
This schedule has a task with a date field on it — that's wrong for our format. Fix the YAML so it validates.

```yaml
calendar: calendar.yaml
items:
  - kind: milestone
    id: 0
    name: Project start
    date: 2026-06-09
  - kind: task
    id: 5
    name: Pour concrete
    timing: auto
    duration: 3d
    date: 2026-06-12
    predecessors: ["0FS"]
```
evals.expected_output: Removes date from the task (only milestones have date), keeps timing, duration, and predecessors, explains the kind constraint

evals.prompt: Run validation on skills/schedule/examples/farmers_market/schedule.yaml and tell me if anything is wrong.
evals.expected_output: Runs validate (or uv run from skills/schedule/) and reports ok for schedule and calendar; does not hand-compute dates

evals.prompt: Add a new task 'Print market map handouts' (1 day) after 'Send press release' in the farmers market example schedule. Assign the next available ID and wire predecessors correctly.
evals.expected_output: Edits schedule YAML only — adds task with timing: auto, duration 1d, predecessor 42FS (or equivalent immediate pred), stable new id, does not write computed dates onto the task

evals.prompt:
Validate this schedule and list every error before changing anything:

```yaml
calendar: calendar.yaml
items:
  - kind: milestone
    id: 0
    name: Project start
    date: 2026-06-09
  - kind: task
    id: 1
    name: Task A
    timing: auto
    duration: 1d
    predecessors: ["0FS"]
  - kind: task
    id: 1
    name: Duplicate
    timing: auto
    duration: 1d
    predecessors: ["0FS"]
  - kind: task
    id: 2
    name: Bad pred
    timing: auto
    duration: 1d
    predecessors: ["nope"]
```
evals.expected_output: Runs validate from skills/schedule/, reports all errors at once (duplicate id and invalid predecessor format), proposes YAML fixes before editing, does not modify skill code

evals.prompt:
Fix this schedule — it has a duplicate task ID:

```yaml
calendar: calendar.yaml
items:
  - kind: milestone
    id: 0
    name: Project start
    date: 2026-06-09
  - kind: task
    id: 3
    name: First
    timing: auto
    duration: 2d
    predecessors: ["0FS"]
  - kind: task
    id: 3
    name: Second
    timing: auto
    duration: 1d
    predecessors: ["0FS"]
```
evals.expected_output: Reassigns one task to the next available id (e.g. 4), keeps timing auto and predecessor rules, validates clean

evals.prompt:
This schedule has a cyclic dependency — fix it:

```yaml
calendar: calendar.yaml
items:
  - kind: milestone
    id: 0
    name: Project start
    date: 2026-06-09
  - kind: task
    id: 1
    name: A
    timing: auto
    duration: 1d
    predecessors: ["2FS"]
  - kind: task
    id: 2
    name: B
    timing: auto
    duration: 1d
    predecessors: ["1FS"]
```
evals.expected_output: Breaks the cycle by changing at least one predecessor link, validates clean, explains which link changed and why

evals.prompt: Run compute on skills/schedule/examples/farmers_market/schedule.yaml and tell me the project finish date, which tasks are on the critical path, and how to open the Gantt chart.
evals.expected_output: Runs uv run compute from skills/schedule/, reports project_finish 2026-07-06 and critical items 60 and 70 from library JSON (is_critical), does not hand-calculate dates, mentions browser URLs or generated artifacts under site/

evals.prompt: The sign vendor confirmed tents and signage work starts Monday May 26 — pin that start on task 31 (Order tents and signage) in the farmers market schedule while keeping duration and predecessors.
evals.expected_output: Sets timing: start_duration with start: 2026-05-26 on task 31, keeps duration 1w and predecessors, does not use a date field, validates before compute
